questions.question: To make Aaron and his sons priests, what did God say to do to them at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting?
God told Moses to sprinkle blood and anointing oil on Aaron, his sons and their garments. What did this do?

answers.text: It consecrated them and their garments
It protected them from their enemies
It sealed a covenant with the tribes

questions.question: God told Israel to offer two lambs every day at the Tent of Meeting. What did He say would happen there?
Why did God say He brought the Israelites out of the land of Egypt?

answers.text: So He could dwell among them
So they could build Him a city
So they could rule over Egypt
